### Review Assessment: TRIAGE Planning & Verification Structure (Round 3)

#### 1. Verification Discovery & Automation Resolution
The execution blocker identified in Round 2 is resolved:
- `phase-plan-v2-TRIAGE.md` now defines `automation.suite_command: node plans/evidence/v2/verify-triage.mjs` within the YAML frontmatter.
- The `## Verification` section provides the four discrete verification commands formatted as backticked bullet items, ensuring standard discovery tools (`discovery.verification_commands_from_plan` and `resolve_suite_command_doc`) locate both individual commands and the overarching suite.

#### 2. Structural Checker Integrity (`verify-triage.mjs`)
- **Inventory & Membership Checks**: `verifyInventory` enforces exact set equality across all 55 historical audit findings (`docs/code-review-2026-09-01.md`), candidate matrix rows (`plans/audit-remediation-disposition-20260905.md`), N/Q case items (`CASE-*`), and cross-cutting sections (3.1–3.4).
- **Negative Controls**: Six in-memory mutation controls (missing finding, missing N/Q case, missing cross-cutting case, duplicate N/Q case, duplicate cross-cutting case, mismatched case ID) verify that mutations alter the source and trigger `AssertionError`.
- **Execution Modes**: The script handles `--inventory-only` strictly and delegates roadmap and git whitespace checks (`phase-loop validate-roadmap`, `git diff --check`, `git diff --cached --check`) when executed without flags.

#### 3. Ownership and Boundary Discipline
- Lane SL-0 retains strict single-lane ownership of planning, reconciliation, and evidence reduction without runtime code creep or writer fanout.
- Interface freeze gate `IF-0-TRIAGE-1` and criteria `EC-TRIAGE-1` through `EC-TRIAGE-3` maintain a clear boundary: structural automation does not substitute for advisor content review or phase acceptance.
- Multi-repo boundaries, license ownership in [Consiliency/omniagent-plus#20](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus/issues/20) (implemented in [Consiliency/omniagent-plus#27](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus/issues/27)), and publication constraints ([Consiliency/agent-harness#789](https://github.com/Consiliency/agent-harness/issues/789)) remain intact.
